summary: John's maternal 3rd great-grandfather; born at San Mango d'Aquino to a bracciale (day-labourer) family.
bio:
Tree: Domenico Fiorillo (1840-1927) + Saveria Colosimo (1848-1926). Round 3: born 27 Dec 1840, San Mango d'Aquino, Nati 1840 act 79; father Carmine Fiorillo, 32, bracciale; mother Giuseppina Ferlaino; one witness was Gaetano Colosimo, 40; the Sindaco was Dr. Bruno Sacco. All 5 of Calabria's documented Fiorillo US arrivals came from San Mango (paese.app); the 1990s San Mango phone directory lists Fiorillo x7. But the parish stati delle anime 1674-1804 have NO Fiorillo, so the family arrived in San Mango in the 1800s.

Domenico (styled 'Gabriele Fiorillo' in the register) married Saveria Colosimo, daughter of Raffaele, in the San Mango parish on 1 April 1870; his father Carmine was already dead ([R4-S1]). Seven children were baptized between 1871 and 1886: Giuseppina (John's ancestor, 1871), Carmelo (1873), Filomena (1874), Carolina (1877), Carmine (1880), Antonio (1884) and Gaetano (1886). Gaetano married Maria Mendicino in 1909 ([R4-S3]). He did not emigrate. The parish burial register records Domenico Fiorillo, aged 81, son of the late Carmine and the late Giuseppa Ferlaino, buried at San Mango on 27 August 1921 ([R4-S2]). This conflicts with the tree's death year of 1927.
